Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

This is a unique opportunity for you to join as an Airbus First Officer on an enhanced salary package with an accelerated command upgrade scenario.
 
 

• You will need to operate the right-hand seat for a minimum of 700 stick hours and successfully complete two Evidence Based Training (EBT) recurrent training modules. 

• Assuming you meet the standards and display the required level of performance, you will then be eligible for accelerated command via an assessment process and an upgrade course. 

To join our Accelerated Command program, you will need the following experience:
 
 

• Minimum of 5,000 hours total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft) 

• Minimum of 2,000 hours command time on Boeing/ Airbus FBW types 

• Minimum 1,000 hours command time on Airbus FBW 

• Airbus FBW type flown within the past 3 years 

• Minimum 150 hours in past 12 months on Airbus FBW/Boeing 

• Valid ICAO ATPL with matching Authority Class 1 Medical 

• ICAO English Level 5 or above  

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

Are you a motivated and technically proficient pilot who delivers excellence?
 

We’re looking for Direct Entry Captains to join our growing team. To become one of our A350 or A380 Captains,
 
 

• you will need a minimum of 7,000 hours total flying time in multi-crew, multi-engine aircraft (only time in the operating seat of a turboprop and/or turbojet aircraft is counted; simulator time is excluded). 

Qualification
 

To become one of our Airbus Captains, you will need: 
 
 

• Minimum 7,000 hrs total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft)  

• Minimum 150 hrs in past 12 months on Airbus FBW as a Captain  

• A valid ICAO ATPL with a matching Authority Class 1 Medical  

• ICAO English level 5 or above  

For A380:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on Airbus FBW wide-body (A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW wide-body as a Captain   

For A350:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on any Airbus FBW (
A320/A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW as a Captain   

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

For an international logistics organization we are looking for a Junior Accountant. This role exists to support accurate accounting, monthly closing, reporting, and audit processes. You will work in a collaborative, multicultural finance team with open communication and opportunities to learn. We are seeking a precise, proactive professional who is comfortable working with figures and asking questions.

Your responsibilities

• 
Process invoices, journal entries, bank bookings, and expense claims in SAP.

• 
Review transactions, investigate discrepancies, and monitor DMS workflows.

• 
Support monthly closing, reconciliations, account checks, and overdue follow-up.

• 
Prepare audit and J-SOX documentation.

• 
Assist colleagues with accounting questions and process improvements.

• 
Provide backup support for reporting and other finance activities.

Your profile

• 
Graduate or Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field.

• 
Approximately 2–3 years of relevant accounting experience.

• 
Knowledge of Belgian accounting principles.

• 
Experience with SAP; DMS knowledge is an advantage.

• 
Accurate, analytical, organized, and proactive.

• 
Fluent in English.

jobs.occupation: Shop Assistant - Christmas Store - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a festive retail environment and helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holidays?

For a charming Christmas decoration store in the historic centre of Bruges, we are looking for a full-time Sales Associate who enjoys customer contact and creating a warm shopping experience.

What will you do:

• Welcoming customers and assisting them with their purchases

• Advising customers on Christmas Decorations, ornaments and gifts

• Keeping the store tidy and visually attractive

• Replenishing shelves and displays

• Operating the cash register and handling payments

• Helping with deliveries and unpacking new products

• You speak English and/or Dutch

• Flexible and willing to work weekends

• Previous experience in retail or sales is a plus
